limits: All sample choices are integer representations of plausible boundary proposals, not millisecond perceptual certification.

The intro contains two separate physical bursts, provisionally labeled repeated Яна after coordinator editorial update. Their lexical identity must be reviewed against actual sound; signal evidence alone cannot establish the additional word.
Direct held-vowel ownership versus low passive decay is especially ambiguous in the lowered second refrain земли. Preserve the range and alternative rather than claiming unanimity.

No global anticipation, shared chorus offset, or mechanical gap filling was applied. Neutral holds below are reading/composition proposals separate from acoustic focus, and close cues should hand off atomically when a fade will not fit.
No timing/editorial baseline was modified by this reviewer.
